hero.label: Governance
hero.headline: Governance & Leadership
hero.subheadline: Gyanteerth Educational Society is governed by a dedicated body of educational professionals committed to institutional integrity, transparency, and academic purpose.

body.text: Gyanteerth Educational Society operates under a formal governance structure established at the time of its registration. The Society is governed by a General Body and managed by an Executive Committee comprising elected office bearers and nominated members drawn from the educational community.

The governance framework is designed to ensure institutional independence, financial transparency, and democratic accountability. All major decisions relating to the Society's programmes, finances, and strategic direction are taken collectively by the governing bodies in accordance with the Society's registered constitution and bye-laws.

Gyanteerth maintains a clear separation between its governance functions and its operational activities, ensuring that the Society's work is guided by educational purpose rather than commercial or institutional interest.

body.text: The General Body is the supreme governing authority of Gyanteerth Educational Society. It comprises all registered members of the Society and meets at least once annually to review the Society's activities, approve accounts, and elect or ratify the Executive Committee.

The General Body has the authority to amend the Society's constitution and bye-laws, approve major policy decisions, and provide overall direction to the Society's work. All members of the General Body are entitled to participate in deliberations and exercise their vote on matters placed before the body.

committees.label: Committees
committees.heading: Standing Committees
committees.intro: The Executive Committee is supported by a set of standing committees responsible for specific functional areas of the Society's work.

items.title: Academic Committee
items.description: Responsible for the design, quality assurance, and oversight of all academic programmes, competitions, and examinations conducted by the Society. The Academic Committee ensures that all Gyanteerth programmes meet the highest standards of academic rigour and credibility.

items.title: Finance Committee
items.description: Responsible for financial oversight, budget approval, audit coordination, and ensuring the Society's financial management adheres to applicable regulations and best practices in institutional governance.

items.title: Membership & Institutional Relations Committee
items.description: Responsible for the management of institutional memberships, onboarding of new member institutions, maintenance of the institutional network, and development of inter-institutional partnerships.

items.title: Events & Programmes Committee
items.description: Responsible for the planning, coordination, and execution of all Gyanteerth events, conferences, conclaves, exhibitions, and institutional programmes at the national and regional levels.

items.title: Communications & Publications Committee
items.description: Responsible for the Society's official communications, publications, digital presence, and public relations — ensuring that Gyanteerth's work is accurately and professionally represented to all stakeholders.

advisory.label: Advisory Council
advisory.heading: Advisory Council

body.text: Gyanteerth is guided by an Advisory Council comprising distinguished educationists, academic administrators, and subject matter experts drawn from across India. The Advisory Council provides strategic counsel to the Executive Committee on matters of educational policy, programme design, and institutional development.

Members of the Advisory Council serve in an honorary capacity and are appointed by the Executive Committee on the basis of their eminence, expertise, and commitment to the advancement of education in India.

items.title: Independence
items.description: Gyanteerth operates as a fully independent educational society, free from affiliation with any single school, coaching institution, or commercial enterprise.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: The Society maintains transparent governance practices, including regular financial reporting, open elections, and accessible records for all registered members.

items.title: Accountability
items.description: All office bearers and committee members are accountable to the General Body and to the Society's registered constitution and bye-laws.

items.title: Integrity
items.description: The Society upholds the highest standards of institutional integrity in all its programmes, partnerships, and governance decisions.
